about: SCUTOONS vector library (owner 2026-10-17): shapes from our own artwork for ornaments, frames and layout. One entry = one future row of the asset database (agents/ASSETS.md: slug, kind, folder, title, tags). `npm run vectors:pull` re-exports every `figma` entry over the SCUTOONS Figma bridge and fills width / height / colors / bytes / sha256; `derived` entries are made from another entry. Vocabulary: shared/tokens/vectors/README.md.
